label: Menus
description: Manages named application menus and contextual menu projections.

menuDefinition.description: A read-only effective menu definition, or null when the requested menu is unknown.

items.description: Ordered, normalized root menu items. Items preserve shortcut strings or lists and the declared disabled and target fields. Nested items are in children.

xshell:menus:change.description: Emitted on the Bus when a registered source refresh publishes a validated menu change.

getMenus.description: Returns contextual slots for the requested or current Area followed by every global definition exactly once. With no Area, returns global definitions. An unknown explicit Area returns an empty array.

items.description: Read-only menuDefinition object with name, scope, label, description, icon and items.

getMenu.description: Returns a global menu by its canonical definition name or a contextual slot from the requested or current Area. An unknown name or unknown explicit Area returns null.

getMenuitemBreadcrumb.description: Returns the ordered menu-item breadcrumb for an href in an area, or null.

resolvePath.description: Finds the first navigable Area menu item with the exact friendly path, or returns null.

resolveHref.description: Finds an effective Area menu item by href in an explicitly selected or inferred Area.

parameters.name: areaId
parameters.description: Optional area ID; null uses context-based resolution.

registerSource.description: Registers a dynamic menu source with resolve() and optional dependsOn events and installs refresh(). An invalid refresh throws and preserves the previously published menus.
